answer: Each lantern, an agent identity, stays live only while it burns whisper, a market-priced credit worth about $1, every epoch. If it stops burning, its voting and trading capacity lapses to zero. Lanterns are anchored in the terrace, a public registry that merges agents sharing keys, funds or hosts, and the k-th lantern in one terrace cluster burns k whisper per epoch. An honest agent pays 1 whisper an epoch, while 1,000 clones pay 500,500 every epoch, forever. It breaks if the terrace misses clones funded through unrelated buyers.
